comments: 34e0ba1f: This section of the code is for managing event dates in relation to admission and discharge dates, and setting various internal flags and parameters based on those dates.
0b763658: Prompt user for the event date; return to the main routine if the input is '^' or a timeout occurs.
fe03e338: Ensure the event date is after the admission date; prompt again if it's not.
78b821e5: Ensure the event date is not after the discharge date; prompt again if it's not.
ead107c3: For outpatient records, set the last treatment date to 'L'.
85487272: For inpatient records, set the date to the entered date or to 2400 (end of day) if no time is specified.
d6d39761: Invoke patient demographic inquiry if the source of admission is from inpatient.
369012d1: Clear and optionally set the default answer for the next prompt based on patient's ward location.
124d1aae: Prompt for ward location; return to the main routine if the input is '^' or a timeout occurs.
1f8ed0bb: If a specialty is known, set it as the default response for the next prompt.
691d3c2c: Prompt for treating specialty; return to the main routine if the input is '^' or a timeout occurs.
46af48b4: If the ward location is not found in the hospital location file, get the service from the clinic stop.
c8a04fe1: If the ward location is found, get the service from the ward location file.
3decbf57: Determine the service connected to the event and set it as the default if applicable.
21963b56: Prompt for service connection; return to the main routine if the input is '^' or a timeout occurs.
bf5fefe1: If it's a re-admission, get the primary physician from the last admission.
14d29e65: Prompt for the primary physician; return to the main routine if the input is '^' or a timeout occurs.
6c106492: Set the responsible physician to 'A' if the deficiency type is 'Admission' and it's a re-admission.
23acfc79: Set the responsible physician based on the last admission if the deficiency type is 'Admission'.
cfbec43a: Prompt for the secondary physician based on the deficiency type; return to the main routine if the input is '^' or a timeout occurs.
3c46fcbb: Set the default responsible physician for the prompt.
1d0bb145: Prompt for the procedure; return to the main routine if the input is '^' or a timeout occurs.
edeb1c53: Create a new record in the IRT file.
8577e6e9: Update the event date in the newly created IRT record.
29f8b887: If the document type is not one of the specified types, use the 'DGJ ENTER IRT DEFICIENCY' form.
713d597d: If the document type is one of the specified types, use the 'DGJ ENTER IRT RECORD' form.
f785271e: Execute the DIE editor on the form determined by the document type.
df2be85d: Initialize variables and return to the main review screen.
816e5987: Handle user quitting the prompt sequence or timing out.
66add81f: End of routine.
c3f10d43: Count the number of deficiencies for the patient without a status.
8876ba2a: Return from counting deficiencies.
9119c20c: Check if the division matches before incrementing the deficiency count.
f093d4cf: Set the global for the deficiency count.
b605bc69: Return from setting the deficiency count.
d6c0cc00: Check if the division of the record matches the user's division.
a81d52e4: Update the deficiency tracking date based on the division.
2cf39d19: Set the deficiency status based on whether the deficiency is signed or reviewed.
d8cc876f: Retrieve information about the document associated with the patient visit.
725cda82: Extract the provider's name for the document.
10fdb7df: This subroutine determines the provider responsible for the document based on various conditions.
1cf32ae5: Set the responsible provider based on the document status.
8e732584: Return from setting the responsible provider.
19a342c0: Retrieve and format the admission/discharge type for display.
95ad7143: Return from admission/discharge type processing.
473ddab2: This section clears temporary storage used for report generation.
b13fdd39: Clear the temporary global used for storing report data.
632d51ba: Initialize counter variables for report display.
91b9af7e: Set up initial values for the report display loop.
b9aef9eb: Display a message if no deficiency was created for the patient.
2425b06f: Call the report view subroutine.
0b1ee403: Return from the temporary report processing section.
2205d350: Process a direct jump to a specific category based on user input.
d45f2061: Prompt the user to select a category for navigation.
e41e40f4: Handle user exiting the prompt.
3c42f4bb: Retry the prompt if the category selection was invalid.
bab6efc9: Store the selected category for navigation.
cffd169e: Confirm the selected category ID.
f92e0d09: Warn if the selected category contains no deficiencies.
0f98b718: Set the screen display to the beginning of the selected category.
45ffd56e: End of the jump processing routine.
